description: Suiko: ask the user before a Write that would replace most of the text of a document under review (allow it only for a full rewrite the user asked for; otherwise change only what the threads ask for: Edit, or the document's sources and a rebuild), and surface sent feedback that no background wait picked up. Every hook prints nothing on error and exits 0, so Claude Code's own prompt still works. The plan-mode gate is opt-in and not part of the plugin: `suiko install claude --with-plan-gate` adds it to settings.json (or copy the hook that `suiko plan-gate --help` prints).
